notes: GiVo Server 1.0 (build 60) for macOS, Windows and Linux/Docker. Recordings now report when a commercial scan finished with nothing found, so the app can say "No breaks found" instead of leaving the badge blank. Portal (Stalker/Ministra) guide refresh re-checks the next longer bulk period every four hours and adopts it only when it is actually deeper, so a provider whose guide depth changes after the first refresh is picked up instead of staying at the first answer. Portal refresh memos are merged on save instead of rewritten, so a restart no longer forgets a lane verdict the process had not read yet.
